site.name: Thames & Severn Way
site.description: Linking the Severn to the Thames following the route of the Stroudwater Navigation and Thames & Severn Canal as closely as possible using public rights of way. As the canals are restored, it will be updated to use the reinstated towpath wherever possible.

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Location and terrain only. OpenStreetMap has no mapped outline for this site.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:relation/14569697 historic=yes 19230 m from ledger point
site is a route relation of 365 parts and none of them outlines the whole site, so no outline is drawn; the scene is fitted to the parts (46145 x 16645 m)
